failures.resolution: Advanced form now hydrates watchdog itco/reset and the XML updater preserves an unchanged watchdog in place.
failures.title: 高级配置表单未回填现有 Watchdog，未修改即保存会生成删除计划
steps: Open VM configuration and expand 高级配置
Observe parsed current configuration contains watchdog model itco/action reset
Observe form shows Watchdog unchecked and model i6300esb
Submit a preview with the untouched UI defaults
failures.expected: An untouched form preserves existing advanced devices, or explicitly warns before removing them.
failures.actual: HTTP 200 preview diff removes <watchdog model="itco" action="reset"/>. The UI does not surface a preservation warning.
suspected_area: watchdog model option compatibility for itco
failures.notes: Preview-only reproduction; no apply request and no remote VM mutation. Backend accepts itco in existing XML read view but the form choices omit itco.

failures.resolution: Ant Design validation rejections are handled as field validation and no longer replace the account page.
failures.title: 账户保存的前端校验异常被渲染成页面数据加载失败
failures.expected: Stay on the account form and show the required-field validation without a page-load error.
failures.actual: No network request is sent, but the page is replaced by 页面数据加载失败 and 账户保存失败; reopening the route is required to recover the form.
suspected_area: Ant Design validation rejection is treated as Error/page state
failures.notes: This matches the previously reported 页面数据加载失败 / 账户保存失败 symptom. A route reload recovers the account form.
